shadows.name: feedback-offset
shadows.purpose: Temporary success and status feedback only.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Disables smooth scrolling and button transition when reduced motion is requested.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Default filled action with black-and-white inversion.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { min-height: 42px; border: 1px solid #0a0a0a; border-radius: 0; padding: 10px 16px; color: #fff; background: #0a0a0a; font: 800 12px Pretendard, sans-serif; transition: color .16s, background .16s; cursor: pointer; } .ds-button-primary:hover { color: #0a0a0a; background: #fff; } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(255,61,0,.38); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Outlined white action for secondary choices.
components.css: .ds-button-secondary { min-height: 42px; border: 1px solid #0a0a0a; border-radius: 0; padding: 10px 16px; color: #0a0a0a; background: #fff; font: 800 12px Pretendard, sans-serif; transition: color .16s, background .16s; cursor: pointer; } .ds-button-secondary:hover { color: #fff; background: #0a0a0a; } .ds-button-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(255,61,0,.38); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Explicit destructive action using error red without changing geometry.
components.css: .ds-button-danger { min-height: 42px; border: 1px solid #0a0a0a; border-radius: 0; padding: 10px 16px; color: #a1190e; background: #fff; font: 800 12px Pretendard, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-button-danger:hover { color: #fff; background: #a1190e; } .ds-button-danger:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(255,61,0,.38); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Sharp white field with visible editorial rule and orange keyboard focus.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 7px; color: #343431; font: 800 11px Pretendard, sans-serif; } .ds-input { width: 100%; min-height: 43px; border: 1px solid #a9a9a4; border-radius: 0; padding: 9px 11px; color: #0a0a0a; background: #fff; font: 400 16px Pretendard, sans-serif; } .ds-input:focus { outline: 3px solid rgba(255,61,0,.38); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Scheduled Badge
components.description: Compact explicit status marker using the single accent.
components.css: .ds-status-badge { display: inline-flex; width: fit-content; padding: 8px 10px; color: #fff; background: #d93600; font: 900 10px/1 Arial, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .02em; }

components.name: Catalog Navigation
components.description: Divided catalog destinations with a small active-state accent.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; min-height: 58px; background: #0a0a0a; } .ds-nav-item { min-width: 92px; border: 0; border-left: 1px solid #333; padding: 0 16px; color: #aaa; background: transparent; font: 700 12px Pretendard, sans-serif; } .ds-nav-item:hover { color: #fff; } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(255,61,0,.38); outline-offset: -3px; } .ds-nav-active { color: #fff; background: #222; } .ds-nav-active::after { content: ''; display: block; width: 5px; height: 5px; margin: 4px auto 0; border-radius: 50%; background: #d93600; }

components.css: .ds-product-card { width: 380px; border: 1px solid #a9a9a4; border-radius: 0; color: #0a0a0a; background: #fff; font-family: Pretendard, sans-serif; } .ds-product-image { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; min-height: 190px; padding: 14px; background: #edede9; font: 700 10px/1 Arial, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .08em; } .ds-product-image b { align-self: flex-start; padding: 8px 10px; color: #fff; background: #d93600; } .ds-product-copy { border-top: 1px solid #a9a9a4; padding: 16px; } .ds-product-copy small { color: #666661; font: 700 9px Arial, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .1em; } .ds-product-copy h3 { margin: 8px 0 12px; font-size: 24px; line-height: 1.13; letter-spacing: -.055em; } .ds-product-copy p { margin: 0 0 10px; } .ds-product-copy strong { color: #d93600; font: 900 24px Arial Black, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -.055em; } .ds-product-copy s { color: #868681; font-size: 12px; } .ds-progress { height: 6px; margin-bottom: 9px; background: #d9d9d5; overflow: hidden; } .ds-progress i { display: block; width: 40%; height: 100%; background: #0a0a0a; } .ds-product-copy > span { font-size: 11px; }

narrative.overview:
0909 Commerce interprets a Seoul fashion-editorial sensibility as a product-first group-buying catalog. Matte black, warm paper white, dense Korean typography, documentary product imagery, and sharp rules make price, status, participation, and timing read before decoration.

The system is deliberately flat and asymmetric. One featured product establishes hierarchy while compact neighboring entries preserve comparison density; responsive layouts keep that hierarchy instead of turning every item into the same card.
keyCharacteristics: Matte black and warm white with rare safety-orange emphasis
Dense, tightly tracked type and one-pixel structural rules

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Safety orange signals price, status, selection, or focus; it is never ambient decoration.

rules.name: The Black-and-White First Rule
rules.body: A screen must remain legible and hierarchically complete before orange is applied.

rules.name: The Compression Rule
rules.body: Tight tracking and compressed leading belong to large headings; body copy retains open leading and normal spacing.

rules.name: The Product Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: Preserve one dominant catalog item and dense comparison neighbors; do not normalize the catalog into equal promotional tiles.

rules.name: The Structural Depth Rule
rules.body: Use rules and tonal separation for persistent hierarchy; reserve hard shadow for temporary feedback.

rules.name: The Sharp Edge Rule
rules.body: Do not round application cards or controls; the catalog's precision depends on square silhouettes.

dos: Do keep product imagery and purchase facts ahead of promotional copy.
Do use one-pixel rules and neutral surface changes to structure dense layouts.
Do preserve visible focus, text status labels, and reduced-motion behavior.
Do keep the mobile five-destination navigation fixed to the bottom edge.
donts: Don't use gradients, glass effects, or soft ambient shadows.
Don't round cards, fields, buttons, badges, or navigation cells.
Don't use safety orange as a decorative background or broad brand wash.
Don't replace the asymmetric catalog with a uniform app-card grid.
